candidate_count_semantics.C: identical to N for all listed r=1..3 calibration counts

selected_carrier.name: EDGE_SUPPORTED_DUAL_CELL_CARRIER
selected_carrier.definition: A triangular-lattice vertex is a dual cell state iff it is an endpoint of at least one edge shared by two occupied AD triangles. On all audited disks this is equivalent to incidence with at least two adjacent occupied triangles.
selected_carrier.D: number of selected dual cells on one complete opposite-axis diameter b=0
selected_carrier.C: number of selected dual cells with at least one of the six dual neighbors absent

zero_bulge_baseline.full_baseline: D6 completion H_r of the constant-step sector path

bulge_definition.official: signed open-sector dual-cell difference between resolved dual disk S_X(r) and H_r: B_X=#((S_X\H_r) with a>0,b>0)-#((H_r\S_X) with a>0,b>0)
bulge_definition.path_control: the boundary-cell path from (r,0) to (0,r) is also stored
bulge_definition.turn_word: six-direction step indices; turns involving the two sector-axis glue steps are excluded from INTERNAL turn classification; remaining nonzero turns are normalized to {-2,-1,+1,+2,+3}

requirements: all internal nonzero turns have outward positive sign
D6-completed dual boundary is one simple closed cycle
reverse traversal agrees after orientation normalization
all six sectors agree by D6
